name: @shadcn-svelte/sv
description: sv add-on that initializes shadcn-svelte and adds components

scripts.demo:create: sv create demo --types ts --template minimal --no-add-ons --no-install && cd demo && pnpm install --ignore-workspace
scripts.demo:add: pnpm build && sv add file:../ --cwd demo --no-git-check
scripts.demo:add:ci: pnpm build && sv add file:../ --cwd demo --no-git-check --no-download-check --no-install
